inputs.scope: Saved source/config/content/art source/test fixtures/Python and PowerShell tools and DLL/module inputs. Does not prove compilation provenance.

combo.scope: Real PIE player/imported clips/actual two-foe HP; manually advanced gameplay-delta boundary cases plus real keyboard and Enhanced Input gamepad gestures. No physical hardware or rendered contact certification.

visual_comparison.limit: Same authored role/player/camera/FOV/options/HP and real PNG dimensions. Popup ages match within one fixed frame and are retained. Instance paths/world time/weather/particles are not claimed pixel-identical. Baseline flag disables only new presentation; S364 gameplay/eligibility fixes remain active in both modes.

preservation.limit: Saved inputs and hash preservation; no independent compilation provenance or external-checkout certification.

controlled_replay.scope: Only the opt-in phase2/3 combo/defense fixture uses engine fixed1/60 gameplay steps. No attack clock, queue threshold, HP, pose or result is directly assigned. Prior timestep is restored before burn/travel and on failure/teardown. Phase2/3 timing is controlled validation, not natural-frame/FPS evidence.

limits: S364 phases2/3 use an opt-in controlled engine1/60 simulation step for deterministic combo/defense input replay. Engine FrameTime/game-clock values in or aggregated with those phases are not natural wall-frame/FPS evidence. Raw measurements are retained; no FPS/performance quality conclusion is drawn.
Bounded seeded cooked Development smoke, not a steady-state or Shipping benchmark, human playthrough or before/after optimization comparison.
No FPS/performance pass thresholds are imposed. Evidence integrity and measurement availability are separate from performance quality.
No warmup was added. Captures, UI, streaming, seeded encounters, file work and profiling overhead can affect observations.
Region/phase/capture/combat tags come from the game thread. Published render/RHI/GPU counters may lag those tags; no exact cross-thread alignment is claimed.
Phase17 is artifact finalization and is excluded from gameplay summaries. Capture/combat groups are separated, not silently pooled into an idle rendering benchmark.
Nearest-rank p50/p95/p99 are computed from actual valid raw samples. Small sample counts remain visible; no percentile is invented from manual min/mean/max aggregates.
GPUTime requires positive raw engine samples. Missing/nonpositive GPU timing is unavailable; CPU/wall timings are never substituted.
Manual scoped CPU, engine thread timing and parallel-task sums measure different scopes and may overlap. Manual scopes exclude separate engine bone refresh and GPU skinning.
RHI texture allocation accounting, one-shot DXGI process LOCAL usage/budget and engine GPUMem counters have different scopes. No texture dimensions are converted to invented VRAM bytes.
The status exit_code is the harness's recorded intent. External process exit/log/fatal validation remains a separate runner responsibility.
120ms is gameplay time; no hardware input-latency measurement.
Defense contacts and early combo are controlled isolated fixtures; existing AI regression remains separate.
Focus RunJson compares RunSnapshot, not separate MemoryDomain bytes.
Visual baseline disables new presentation only; new gameplay/eligibility fixes remain active in both.
No physical pad, human full playthrough, Shipping, long-session or before/after FPS certification.
